subject: Automatically constrain factor loadings to be the same in multi-group comparison

messages.author: b5f242e7eb90c7c9
messages.subject: Automatically constrain factor loadings to be the same in multi-group comparison
parts:
Hi all,
 
I found an issue when using lavaan, when using mimic="Mplus". I am trying to conduct multigroup comparison. When using without the Mplus mimic function, the model runs fine. Strangely, when using the mimic function, the programme automatically constrains factor loadings to be the same across groups. Not sure if it is intended.
 
Chester

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Automatically constrain factor loadings to be the same in multi-group comparison
parts:
Hi Chester

That is intended. That is how Mplus work with a multiple group model, by default set the factor loadings and intercepts to be equal across groups. With the mimic="Mplus", you are asking lavaan to behave however mplus behaves

-- Mauricio

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Automatically constrain factor loadings to be the same in multi-group comparison
parts:
For lavaan the syntax always comes first. If you explicitly tell in your syntax that the factor loadings are different, then it overwrites the mimic argument. For example:

f1 =~ c(a1,a2)*y1+y2+y3

Even with mimic=mplus, the factor loading for y1 is going to be different at everry group.

But if you dont say it explicitly the mimic argument can act freely

bye
